2.057.report_location: Assignment Information - Contact Information - Property Data Report - Reference ID

data_points.definition: An identifier or number used by the inspecting professional to identify the report.

display_rules.table: Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report

2.060.report_location: Assignment Information - Contact Information - Property Data Report - Inspection Date

data_points.definition: The date the inspection of the property was performed.

display_rules.table: Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report

compliance.text: Provide the date the property inspection was performed.
compliance.logic: If PropertyDataReportIndicator = "true" and InspectionDate is not provided in SERVICE container with ServiceType = "Inspection"
compliance.label: Property Data Report - Inspection Date

data_points.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the method by which the exterior inspection was conducted.

enumerations.definition: No exterior inspection of the property was completed.
An in-person, exterior inspection of the property was completed.
An exterior inspection of the property was completed using an electronic device conducted via interactive or recorded (non-interactive) video.

display_rules.table: Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report

compliance.text: Provide the manner in which the Property Data Collector conducted the exterior inspection.
compliance.logic: If PropertyDataReportIndicator = "true" and PropertyExteriorInspectionMethodType is not provided in SERVICE container with ServiceType = "Inspection"
compliance.label: Exterior

data_points.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the method by which the interior inspection was conducted.

enumerations.definition: No interior inspection of the property was completed.
An in-person, interior inspection of the property was completed.
An interior inspection of the property was completed using an electronic device conducted via interactive or recorded (non-interactive) video.

display_rules.table: Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report

compliance.text: Provide the manner in which the Property Data Collector conducted the interior inspection.
compliance.logic: If PropertyDataReportIndicator = "true" and PropertyInteriorInspectionMethodType is not provided in SERVICE container with ServiceType = "Inspection"
compliance.label: Interior

2.053.report_location: Assignment Information - Contact Information - Property Data Report - Name

data_points.definition: The first name of the individual represented by the parent object.
The last name of the individual represented by the parent object.
The middle name of the individual represented by the parent object.
The name suffix of the individual represented by the parent object. (E.g., JR = Junior, SR = Senior, etc.)

display_rules.table: Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report

2.055.report_location: Assignment Information - Contact Information - Property Data Report - Company Name

data_points.definition: The unparsed name of either an individual or a legal entity.

display_rules.table: Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report

2.056.report_location: Assignment Information - Contact Information - Property Data Report - Company Address

data_points.definition: The address with the address number, pre-directional, street name, post-directional, address unit designators and address unit value.
The name of the city or Military APO FPO designation.
The postal code (ZIP Code in the US) for the address. ZIP Code may be either 5 or 9 digits.
The two-character representation of the US state, US Territory, Canadian Province/Territory, or Military Address abbreviation (for example: AE, AP, AA).

display_rules.table: Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report
Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report
Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report
Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report

2.054.report_location: Assignment Information - Contact Information - Property Data Report - Occupation

data_points.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the primary occupation of the identified party role.

enumerations.definition: A party who performs valuation services in compliance with USPAP and in a manner that is independent, impartial and objective.
An individual who performs appraiser related tasks within the valuation process while operating under the supervision of an appropriately licensed and qualified appraiser.
An individual that conducts an examination of the condition of residential improvements, features and systems (e.g. electrical, plumbing, sewage disposal, HVAC systems, roof).
An individual qualified to conduct an inspection or evaluation of residential improvements for insurance related matters (e.g. storm damage).
An individual that represents a buyer or seller in the sale or a client in the lease of real estate.

data_points.definition: A free-form text field that specifies the enumeration when the value of Other is used for Primary Occupation Type.

display_rules.table: Assignment Information: Contact Information – Property Data Report

25.054.report_location: Cost Approach - General Description - Effective Date

data_points.conditionality_details: IF CostApproachIndicator = "true" AND (DataSourceType = "BuilderOrDeveloper" OR "CostService" OR "CostSurvey" OR "Other")
data_points.definition: The effective date of the source of information.

display_rules.rule: Display when @ValuationUseType = “SubjectProperty” AND CostApproachIndicator = “true” AND (DataSourceType = “BuilderOrDeveloper” OR “CostService” OR “CostSurvey” OR “Other”)

compliance.text: Provide the 'Effective Date' for the Cost Data Source.
compliance.logic: If CostApproachIndicator = "true", and (DataSourceType = "BuilderOrDeveloper" or "CostService" or "CostSurvey" or "Other"), and DataSourceEffectiveDate is not provided in the instance of DATA_SOURCE that is related to cost approach
compliance.label: Effective Date

4.110.report_location: Site - Site Valuation Methodology - Data Source

data_points.definition: A unique alphanumeric string identifying the record as assigned by the Data Source Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that identifies the sources of data.

enumerations.definition: Publicly available property data provided by a local jurisdictional authority.
The party who constructed the property improvements serving as collateral for the mortgage loan.
A questionnaire generally created by the lender sent to the condominium board or management agent to obtain relevant project details.
A collection of individuals responsible for the management and operations of the cooperative.
A questionnaire generally created by the lender sent to the cooperative board or management agent to obtain relevant project details.
A legal entity that is responsible for managing residential properties bound by neighborhood covenants and restrictions, planned unit developments, cooperatives or condominium communities.
A database established by cooperating real estate brokers to provide property characteristics and transaction information.

enumerations.definition: An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Includes summits and rift zones of Kilauea and Mauna Loa volcanoes, where vents have been repeatedly active in historical time.

An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Areas adjacent to and downslope of zone 1. 15-25% of zone 2 has been covered by lava since 1800, and 25-75% has been covered within the past 750 years. An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Areas less hazardous than zone 2 because of greater distance from recently active vents and/or because of topography. 1-5% of zone 3 has been covered since 1800, and 15-75% has been covered within the past 750 years.

An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Includes all of Hualalai, where the frequency of eruptions is lower than that for Kilauea or Mauna Loa. Lava coverage is proportionally smaller, about 5% since 1800, and less than 15% within the past 750 years.
An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Area on Kilauea currently protected by topography.
An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Two areas on Mauna Loa, both protected by geography.
An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Younger part of Mauna Kea volcano - 20% of this area was covered by lava in the past 10,000 years.

An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - covers the remaining part of Mauna Kea, only a few percent of this area has been covered by lava in the past 10,000 years.
An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Kohala Volcano, which last erupted over 60,000 years ago.

4.032.report_location: Site - Site Influence - Permanent Waterfront Feature

data_points.context: Subject Property: Site Influence - Bodies of Water - Waterfrontage
data_points.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a natural or man-made component that can reside in or along side a body of water.

enumerations.definition: A strip of land separating a body of water from inland areas, typically used for recreation or leisure purposes.
A machine for raising and lowering watercraft to and from the water.
A form of access point, leading to a body of water, for boats or other watercraft.
A docking point for boats or other watercraft.
A platform leading out from shore into a body of water. Not attached to pillars or girders. Can be permanently installed or temporary in nature in order to allow for removal due to seasonality.
A permanent structure leading out from shore into a body of water. Typically made of concrete, steel, or treated timbers that is supported on pillars or girders.
Rock or other material set in place to protect shorelines (e.g. shot rock, rock armor, or rubble).
A wall or structure designed to protect shorelines from wave loads and/or to retain soil and prevent erosion.

compliance.label: Permanent Waterfront Feature

enumerations.definition: An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Includes summits and rift zones of Kilauea and Mauna Loa volcanoes, where vents have been repeatedly active in historical time.

Relative hazard within zone 2 decreases gradually as one moves away from Zone 1.

An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Areas less hazardous than zone 2 because of greater distance from recently active vents and/or because of topography. 1-5% of zone 3 has been covered since 1800, and 15-75% has been covered within the past 750 years.

An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Includes all of Hualalai, where the frequency of eruptions is lower than that for Kilauea or Mauna Loa. Lava coverage is proportionally smaller, about 5% since 1800, and less than 15% within the past 750 years.

An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Two areas on Mauna Loa, both protected by geography.
An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Younger part of Mauna Kea volcano - 20% of this area was covered by lava in the past 10,000 years.

An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - covers the remaining part of Mauna Kea, only a few percent of this area has been covered by lava in the past 10,000 years.
An area designated by the United States Geological Survey for the Island of Hawai'i - Kohala Volcano, which last erupted over 60,000 years ago.

enumerations.definition: The estimated cost to construct, at current prices as of the effective date of the appraisal, a building with utility equivalent to the building being appraised, using modern materials, current standards, design, and layout.

The estimated cost to construct, at current prices, as of the effective date of the appraisal, an exact duplicate or replica of the building being appraised, using the same materials, construction standards, design, layout, and quality of workmanship, and embodying all of the deficiencies, superadequacies, and obsolescence of the subject building.

data_points.definition: A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the methodology used to arrive at a replacement or reproduction building cost.

enumerations.definition: A method used to derive a cost estimate in terms of dollars per unit of area, or volume, based on known cost of similar structures that are adjusted for time, and physical differences. The cost estimate is then applied to the total building area. Also known as Square Foot Method or Market Extraction Method.
A cost-estimating method used to derive the total cost of labor and materials for each individual item used in the construction of the improvements (e.g. nails, drywall, bricks, mortar).
A cost-estimating method in which total building cost is estimated by adding together the unit cost for various building components as installed. Also known as Segregated Cost Method.
